title: Interacting Particle Systems on Random Graphs
abstract: The present overview of interacting particle systems on random graphs collects the notes of a mini-course given by the authors at the Brazilian School of Probability, 5--9 August 2024, in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil. The content is a personal snapshot of an interesting area of research at the interface between probability theory, combinatorics, statistical physics and network science that is developing rapidly.
